Her family disowned her for marrying a poor mechanic… until the truth came out. 

When Adaora chose love over wealth, her wealthy father threw her out of their Lagos mansion and declared, "She is no longer my daughter." Her mother mocked her. Her brother laughed at her. The entire family believed she had wasted her life on a man with grease-stained hands.

But what they didn't know was that Kingsley — the humble mechanic they despised — was secretly building an empire. While they judged him by his dirty overalls, he was quietly studying business at night, reviving a dying automobile company his grandfather left him. 

Years later, when pride and bad investments destroyed the Okeke family fortune, the same family that rejected Adaora came begging for help. And on the day their mansion was about to be auctioned, a black luxury convoy pulled into the compound… and the mechanic they mocked stepped out as the Executive Chairman of one of West Africa's fastest-growing companies.

This emotional African story will teach you why you should NEVER judge people by their appearance. Sometimes the seed you laugh at today is the harvest God is already preparing. 🌱

title: Teaching in UK Without QTS | 5 Route options + How to Get QTS Later
description:
Can you teach in England without Qualified Teacher Status (QTS)? The answer is YES - and in this video, I break down exactly where you can teach without QTS, the roles available to you, and how you can get your QTS later while teaching.

If you're an aspiring teacher (especially immigrant teachers) wondering how to start your UK teaching career before you have QTS, this video is for you.

The video contains:

Introduction: Can You Teach Without QTS?
What is QTS?
Where You CAN Teach Without QTS
Common Teaching Roles Without QTS
Specialist Teacher Opportunities (STEM & Languages)
How to Get QTS LATER (3 Routes)
Assessment Only Route
School Centered Initiative
Employer Supported Training Routes
Conclusion & Next Steps

❓ **COMMON QUESTIONS:**

**Q: Can I teach in state schools without QTS?**
A: In limited roles, yes. Cover supervisor, supply teaching, and some specialist positions don't require QTS. But for permanent, full-time teaching positions in state schools, you'll eventually need QTS.

**Q: Do independent schools require QTS?**
A: No. Many independent/private schools hire teachers without QTS, especially if you have strong subject expertise or international teaching qualifications.

**Q: How long does it take to get QTS?**
A: Depends on the route:
- Assessment Only: 3-12 months
- SCITT/School Centered: 1 year
- Employer Supported: 1-2 years

**Q: Can I start teaching immediately as an immigrant?**
A: Yes, if you have the right visa (Skilled Worker visa or Student visa for teacher training). You can work in non-QTS roles while sorting out your qualifications.

**Q: Will I get paid the same without QTS?**
A: Generally, QTS teachers earn more than non-QTS teachers. But supply teaching and specialist roles can still pay well (£80-150/day for supply). Once you get QTS, your earning potential increases significantly.

title: UK REVERSES QTS FOR MOST TEACHERS IN NIGERIA, GHANA AND OTHERS | 2023 QTS VLOG
description:
The most recent update for the fairer approach to QTS states that only applicants with a subject specialism in languages, mathematics or science and a teaching qualification to teach 11 to 16 year olds from the following 7 countries will be able to use the service to check if they meet the requirements for QTS and apply:

Ghana
India 
Jamaica 
Nigeria
Singapore 
South Africa
Zimbabwe

If you are a teacher with a qualification from Ghana, India, Jamaica, Nigeria, Singapore, South Africa or Zimbabwe, you must also have one of the following:

a teaching qualification that meets the standard of a level 6 qualification qualifying you to teach children aged 11 to 16 in mathematics, languages or science

a teaching qualification that meets the standard of a level 6 qualification qualifying you to teach children aged 11 to 16, and a bachelor’s degree made up of at least 50% mathematics, science or a language (excluding English) taught in English state schools, for example:

French
German
Italian
Japanese
Latin
Mandarin
Russian
Spanish

title: QNET Success Stories | V Partner Kavita Sugandh
description:
Meet V Partner Kavita Sugandh, a true success story of determination and hard work. Coming from a lower middle-class family supported by her father’s small business, she had to work her way up in the corporate world. But even after starting and growing her own HR consultancy, she quickly realised that wanted more from life. 
 
When she was introduced to QNET, things started to change. At first, she was skeptical, but after attending her first V-Convention, her eyes were opened to the business's potential. She decided to start QNET full-time, even though it wasn't easy to build her network; while many were attracted to the rewards of the business, only some were willing to do the hard work required. She persevered and found people who shared her vision and excitement for direct selling and its future.
 
VP Kavita Sugandh's success story with QNET is truly remarkable and inspiring. Through consistency and perseverance, she reached big goals and quickly climbed the sales ranks at QNET. When asked about what keeps her motivated, she credits her desire to be able to afford the best of the best for herself and her family. She also credits QNET products as some of the best and essential to her daily life. 
 
Along her journey, VP Kavita has learned many valuable lessons. The most important is to avoid getting stuck in past successes and failures as it stifles growth. The second is that the only way to be relevant is to help others grow. To those new to the business, she advises being grateful for the journey and the ups and downs because that means you're alive, and that only makes success more exciting and fulfilling.

title: PERJALANAN MUDIK ‼️Trip Report Citilink QG 717 Surabaya (SUB) - Jakarta (CGK)  |  A320-200 (PK-GLP)
description:
Halo teman-teman aviation geek dan selamat datang kembali di channel saya! Kali ini saya mengajak kalian untuk ikut dalam perjalanan udara domestik yang cukup padat, yaitu rute dari Surabaya (SUB) menuju Jakarta (CGK) bersama maskapai Citilink dengan nomor penerbangan QG-717. 

Perjalanan dimulai dari Terminal 1 Bandara Internasional Juanda, di mana seluruh proses check-in berjalan lancar hingga akhirnya saya mendapatkan kursi di Seat 16E, sebuah center seat yang berada di sisi kanan pesawat.

Armada yang akan membawa kita sore ini adalah Airbus A320-200 dengan registrasi PK-GLP, yang baru saja menyelesaikan penerbangan sebaliknya (QG-716) dari Jakarta. Pesawat ini mengandalkan dua mesin tangguh CFMI CFM56-5B4/P dan memiliki konfigurasi full economy class berkapasitas 180 kursi. Sebagai informasi tambahan bagi Anda yang suka memantau kabin, Citilink membagi area kursinya menjadi Green Zone (baris depan dan emergency exit) serta Regular Zone. 

Kursi 16E yang saya tempati masuk dalam kategori Regular Zone, terletak tepat beberapa baris di belakang pintu darurat (Seat 12 & 14) yang terkenal dengan ruang kakinya yang ekstra luas.

Åtskilliga båtar har skeppat björkstock från hamnarna i Karlstad och Västerås men även från en norrlandshamn. title: Björk Post 1995: el álbum que destruyó todas las reglas del pop comercial
description:
¿Cómo suena el futuro cuando decides ignorar absolutamente todas las reglas del pop? Suena exactamente como Post de Björk — y en 1995 nadie estaba preparado para eso.
Tras el éxito masivo de su debut, la disquera y el mundo esperaban que Björk repitiera la fórmula. En su lugar, la islandesa lanzó Post: un álbum tan esquizofrénico y brillante que hizo volar por los aires cualquier concepto tradicional de lo que debía ser la música comercial. No había fórmula, no había género, no había límite — había una mente que absorbía toda la vanguardia de la escena electrónica de Londres y la escupía a su manera sin pedir permiso a nadie.
En la misma licuadora metió techno industrial, trip-hop, cuerdas cinematográficas y el cover de una big band de los años 50. Army of Me arrancaba el disco con una base pesada e industrial que no tenía nada de comercial. It's Oh So Quiet explotaba en un caos de big band eufórica que parecía sacada de un musical de Hollywood. Y luego llegaba Hyperballad — una de las canciones más vulnerables y poéticas que la electrónica haya producido jamás — para demostrar que lo raro y lo accesible no eran opuestos: eran la misma cosa en manos correctas.
Post no era solo una colección de canciones. Era un diario hiperactivo de su vida en Londres, un documento sonoro de una artista que decidió que su universo más extraño era exactamente el regalo que el mundo necesitaba. Destruyó la frontera entre lo experimental y lo popular, y creó un pop extraterrestre que inspiró a toda una generación a dejar de sonar como los demás.
La verdadera vanguardia no es hacer música incomprensible para alejar a la gente — es tener el coraje de abrir las puertas de tu universo más raro y obligar a todo el planeta a entrar a jugar. ¿Cuál es para ti la canción más alucinante de Post, maníacos? Déjala en los comentarios. Y si no conectas con esto... tranquilo, no es para todos. Pero si sí conectas, suscríbete.

UPSC Civil Services Examination को देश की सबसे कठिन परीक्षाओं में से एक माना जाता है. हर साल लाखों aspirants इस परीक्षा की तैयारी करते हैं, लेकिन कुछ कहानियां ऐसी होती हैं जो केवल सफलता की कहानी नहीं बल्कि संघर्ष, इच्छाशक्ति और विश्वास की कहानी बन जाती हैं.

This documentary tells the complete, fact-based story of Arun Gulab Gawli — the milkman's son from Dagdi Chaal who became one of Mumbai's most feared underworld dons, and later, a sitting MLA in the Maharashtra Assembly. From the textile mill strikes that destroyed Bhaykhala's working class, to his entry into the Bhaykhala Company gang, his deadly alliance and eventual war with Dawood Ibrahim, the 1992 JJ Hospital massacre, his transformation into a political "Daddy" backed by Shiv Sena, and his final downfall under MCOCA — this is the full, untold saga of a man who ruled Mumbai's streets, sat in its Parliament, and ended his story behind bars.


Key Topics Covered in This Video:
Arun Gawli's early life in Dagdi Chaal and the Bombay Textile Mill Strike
Formation of Bhaykhala Company and its alliance with Dawood Ibrahim
The killing of Mannya Surve and Samad Khan — Pathan gang's downfall
The Jogeshwari land dispute that broke Gawli's friendship with Dawood
The murders of Rama Naik, Babu Reshim, and Gawli's own brother Pappa Gawli
The 1992 JJ Hospital attack and Ismail Parkar's murder
Gawli's rise as "Daddy," Shiv Sena's support, and his MLA win in 2004
The Jamsandekar murder, MCOCA conviction, and his 2025 release



Why This Story Matters:
Arun Gawli's story is not just about one gangster — it's about a Mumbai that mill closures broke, unemployment scarred, and a failed system pushed toward street justice. It's the story of how poverty, loyalty, and betrayal can turn an ordinary boy into a feared don — and how power, once tasted, can blind even the smartest men to their own downfall. This is history written in blood, ambition, and consequence — a mirror to a city that built empires on both sides of the law.
